intro: Slither, collect ingredients, and brew tea inside your snake. Complete cozy shifts in this modern twist on a classic. Classic score attack mode included!
description:
Slither across a grid, gather ingredients, and brew tea inside your snake’s body. Gather score by completing goals, brewing tea in order to pop segments and just growing longer.
Chai Glide is a cozy reimagining of the classic snakey game built for calming play sessions.
Want old-school pressure instead? Classic Mode is a fast paced core run. Pick your speed, grab pellets, race timed bonus ingredients before they vanish, and go for the high sSsSSscore!
